candidates.requirement: Make the changed no-reallocate printing path executable through the target's printing operation.
candidates.target_route: Initialize a supported custom allocation hook, then parse and call cJSON_Print or cJSON_PrintUnformatted.
candidates.failure_condition: The target never changes the default hooks, whose reallocate function is non-NULL, so no input enters the changed copy path.
candidates.alternative_paths: Both unbuffered APIs use the same hooks; buffered printing bypasses this path. Input flags cannot change hooks.
